dialogues.speaker: Philby
dialogues.text: Ugh, taking the path through The Chasm to Sumeru was a bad idea.

dialogues.speaker: Philby
dialogues.text: I thought it was a shortcut, but a nobody like me couldn't get through those blockades, so I had to go all the way around instead!

dialogues.speaker: Philby
dialogues.text: That really exhausted me...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, it sounds like it was a bad idea.

dialogues.speaker: Philby
dialogues.text: *sigh* Don't remind me. It's too late now.

dialogues.speaker: Philby
dialogues.text: It's my fault for heading to Liyue after leaving Mondstadt, and then going straight to Sumeru. I wasn't able to plan my route properly. I should have gone to Fontaine first.

dialogues.speaker: Philby
dialogues.text: Luckily, I've finally arrived at civilization, so let me rest here for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you plan to continue?

dialogues.speaker: Philby
dialogues.text: Uh... Of course. But give me a while to rest up.

dialogues.speaker: Philby
dialogues.text: Since I'm already here, I have to pay a visit to Sumeru City. The locals told me that I should attend the festivals held there if I can.

dialogues.speaker: Philby
dialogues.text: For example, there's something called the Sabzeruz Festival, which celebrates the birthday of Lesser Lord Kusanali.

dialogues.speaker: Philby
dialogues.text: But when I asked if Lesser Lord Kusanali is also called the Goddess of Flowers, they shook their heads, and said that the Goddess of Flowers and the Dendro Archon aren't the same god. It seems that the Greater Lord and Lesser Lord Kusanali aren't the same god either.

dialogues.speaker: Philby
dialogues.text: I don't understand. Then why is Lesser Lord Kusanali's birthday called "Sabzeruz Festival"? That's just being obtuse!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Rest well.

dialogues.speaker: Philby
dialogues.text: Thanks, I will.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wise choice.

dialogues.speaker: Philby
dialogues.text: Thanks for the approval. It gives me confidence in my own decision.

dialogues.speaker: Philby
dialogues.text: It does look pretty safe with so many Forest Rangers here.

dialogues.speaker: Philby
dialogues.text: A young girl with green hair tried to say something to me when she heard that I'm a Mondstadter, but she didn't say anything in the end.

dialogues.speaker: Philby
dialogues.text: What was up with that? I was too tired to bother asking for details. I'll ask about it should I meet her again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you plan to continue adventuring?

dialogues.speaker: Philby
dialogues.text: Uh... Of course. But I'll need a while to rest up, I think.
